title: Pure Venom
summary: Pure Venom Reptile control and alternate win-condition strategy, utilizing toxic Venom Counters and the swamp to wither opponent monsters down to 0 ATK. The deck floods the graveyard with Reptiles via Snake Rain to fuel Vennominon the King of Poisonous Snakes and awaken the invincible deity Vennominaga.

summary.title: Starters
points: Snake Rain discards 1 card to send 4 Reptile monsters directly from your Deck to the GY, instantly loading 2000 ATK onto Vennominon and priming GY recursion.
Venom Swamp places a Venom Counter on each face-up non-Venom monster during each End Phase, reducing their ATK by 500 per counter and automatically destroying them if their ATK reaches 0.
Venom Shot sends a Reptile monster from your Deck to the GY to place 2 Venom Counters on a face-up monster.
Venom Serpent, Venom Snake, and Venom Boa place additional Venom Counters each turn while chipping away at opposing monsters.
Reptilianne Echidna is a Link-2 Reptile that reduces an opponent's monster's ATK to 0 upon summon and searches Reptile monsters with different names up to the number of 0 ATK monsters on the field.

summary.title: Opening: Snake Rain + Vennominon Setup
steps: Activate Snake Rain, discarding a card to send 4 Reptiles (such as Venom Serpent, Snake, Boa, and Cobra) from Deck to GY.
Activate Venom Swamp, establishing passive ATK reduction across the opponent's field.
Tribute Summon Vennominon the King of Poisonous Snakes using a Reptile, or set up Snake Whistle / Rise of the Snake Deity.
Vennominon gains 500 ATK for each Reptile in your GY (starting at 2000+ ATK).
During the opponent's turn, when Vennominon is destroyed by card effect, trigger Rise of the Snake Deity to awaken Vennominaga.

summary.title: The Snake Deities & Alternate Win Condition
points: Vennominon the King of Poisonous Snakes gains 500 ATK for every Reptile monster in your GY, and can banish 1 other Reptile from GY to Special Summon itself when destroyed by battle.
Rise of the Snake Deity activates when a face-up Vennominon you control is destroyed by a card effect, Special Summoning Vennominaga the Deity of Poisonous Snakes from your hand or Deck.

Vennominaga the Deity of Poisonous Snakes is completely unaffected by Spells, Traps, and other monster effects, cannot be destroyed by battle, gains 500 ATK per Reptile in GY, and places a Hyper-Venom Counter on itself when it inflicts battle damage to the opponent.
When Vennominaga accumulates 3 Hyper-Venom Counters, you immediately win the Duel.
Vennominaga can banish 1 other Reptile from your GY to revive itself from the GY when destroyed by battle.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Snake Deity's Command reveals a Venom monster in hand to negate and destroy an opponent's Spell Card.
Ambush Fangs negates an attack on a face-up Venom monster, ends the Battle Phase, and places a Venom Counter on the attacking monster.
Venom Burn removes all Venom Counters from a monster to inflict 700 damage to the opponent for each counter removed.
Snake Whistle Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Reptile monster from your Deck whenever a Reptile monster you control is destroyed.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Starving Venom and Predaplant Dragon variants are excluded because they belong to the DARK Dragon/Plant Fusion archetype and require external materials incompatible with pure Reptile Venom strategies.
